## Beschreibung

Was im Moor versinkt, kommt nicht immer als das wieder herauf, was es war.

## Hinweise

An adversary on the large card, written in the frontmatter with the
note's own spellings (`display-name`, `img`, `armour`) and its
description as a `## Beschreibung` section: the features, the five
small diamonds with hate, the large attribute diamond, the two lists, the
picture with the name over it on the back. This section is a property
nobody binds and stays off the card. Invented for this deck.

```card-forge
card:
  system: tor2e
  card-type: npc
```
